children: Solana social wallet Hey Wallet said on X that it will shut down its product. According to ChainCatcher, the wallet allowed users to send SOL through posts, tip creators, mint NFTs, and trade on X, Discord, and Telegram.
Hey Wallet thanked users who used these features and reminded them to back up their wallets.

title: Solana Social Wallet Hey Wallet Says It Will Shut Down Its Product
